completion:
Collect samples regularly.
3. Use calibrated instruments.
4. Define the parameters to be monitored.
5. Measure the concentration of pollutants.
6. Compare with permissible limits.
7. Use appropriate statistical methods.
8. Document weather conditions.
9. Identify the source of emissions.
10. Record deviations and exceedances.
11. Detail the methodology used in monitoring.
12. Include visual evidence where possible.
13. Collate data into a comprehensive format.
14. Analyze trends and patterns.
15. Provide recommendations for remediation actions.
16. Supplement with maps and graphs.
17. Review report for accuracy and completeness.
18. Involve all relevant stakeholders in the process.
19. Keep detailed records of maintenance and instrument calibration.
20. Submit the report to regulatory bodies in a timely manner.
